text:
Maya: Quick sync from DD-482 postmortem follow-up. We need a concrete plan for test coverage + runbooks: regression entry, promptset for cache-thrash, focused load profile (single & multi-region), and a chaos drill.

Priya: I can take the multi-region load profile. I'll capture the exact burst shape we saw and reproduce it in k6.

Tom: I'll own the runbook updates and the chaos drill orchestration. Proposed drill window: 2029-04-02 16:00 UTC.

Samir: I will add the regression test and make it gate the routing-layer change. New task: OPS-2034. ETA 7 business days for PR + CI job.

Maya: Samir, make sure the regression asserts on eviction_rate and average_latency p50/p95. Thresholds: eviction_rate < 0.05 over 2m, p95 < 800ms.

Samir: Got it. I'll add PromQL assertions:```
avg_over_time(kv_eviction_rate[2m]) < 0.05
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_bucket[1m])) by (le)) < 0.8
```

oncall-bot: Incident DD-482 postmortem: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DD-482/postmortem (recorded)

Priya: For the k6 script I plan two scenarios: steady-state ramp to 8k, and spiky cross-region bursts hitting 14k aggregate. Will include network emulation for 100ms RTT in cross-region.

DevOps-Eng: Please ensure we run cross-region bursts from EU + US + APAC nodes to match customer geometry. I can provide terraform for ephemeral clients.

Tom: Chaos plan: during peak of the spiky scenario, trigger node restarts and simulated network partitions between zones. I'll write steps into chaos-runbook.md and include escalation contacts.

Maya: Who will own the promptset and eval threshold? We need a short repro and a longer conversation sequence that triggers cache churn.

Samir: Elena had offered earlier but is busy this sprint. I can draft a minimal promptset (short path + long tail) and hand off to Elena for human-quality thresholds. New task OPS-2035.

Priya: Timeline check: I can have the k6 scripts and infra config ready in 5 working days.

Tom: I'll schedule the chaos window on the calendar and run a dry-run with the dev cluster a few days before.

Maya: Ownership recap: Samir -> regression + promptset initial draft (OPS-2034/2035), Priya -> load profiles + infra, Tom -> chaos drill + runbooks, DevOps-Eng -> ephemeral client infra. I'll link all tasks under parent task OPS-2033.

Samir: One technical request: the regression should include a synthetic client that uses KV access patterns with TTL churn. I'll add a helper in tests/clients/ttl_churn.go and a docker image for CI.

Priya: Also, add a ci-seed dataset for promptset to make the evals reproducible. I'll add example traffic generator for the long tail.

DevOps-Eng: Reminder: run the load test in both IPv4 and dual-stack network modes; we saw a slight difference in behavior historically.

Maya: Thank you. Please post PR links and Jira numbers here when created. We'll pull this into next SRE triage if anything slips. React if you agree. :white_check_mark:
